sections.heading: Advent Calendar Drawer Box FAQ
sections.text: Questions Advent Calendar Drawer Box FAQ How many drawers can an advent calendar box have? The drawer count and size are set by your products and confirmed after we review the structure. Common countdowns use 12, 24 or 25 drawers. When should I order an advent calendar box for Christmas? Start early: the structure, drawer layout and a physical sample are approved before bulk production, and freight time comes on top. Overseas orders for Christmas are usually placed in early summer. We confirm the full schedule on the quote. Can every drawer have a different size? Yes, drawers can be sized to different products, which is reviewed together with the overall layout of the cabinet. Is there a version with doors? Yes. The advent calendar cabinet with doors closes like a gift box and opens onto the drawers; see the related link below.

The classic advent calendar drawer box: a rigid cabinet with a grid of small pull-out drawers, each numbered for one day of the countdown and opened with a ribbon pull. Brands fill the drawers with miniatures, jewelry, chocolates or samples, and the cabinet is kept as a storage box after the season.
